name: Old Fashioned
ingredients: 45ml Bourbon or Rye Whiskey, 1 Sugar Cube, 2 dashes Angostura Bitters, Water
desc: A foundational whiskey cocktail that balances sweetness, bitterness, and spirit strength.
recipe: Place a sugar cube in an old-fashioned glass and saturate with 2 dashes of bitters and a few dashes of water.
In case of non bitters use an orange or lemon zest twisted over the glass or muddle orange slice in the glass with sugar
Muddle the sugar until dissolved.
Fill the glass with ice cubes and add 45ml of whiskey.
Stir gently and garnish with an orange slice and a cocktail cherry.

name: Negroni
ingredients: 30ml Gin, 30ml Campari, 30ml Sweet Red Vermouth
desc: An iconic Italian aperitivo known for its vibrant red color and perfectly balanced bitter-sweet profile.
recipe: Pour 30ml gin, 30ml Campari, and 30ml sweet vermouth into an old-fashioned glass filled with ice.
Stir gently for 30 seconds to chill and achieve proper dilution.
Express the oils of an orange peel over the glass.
Garnish with the orange peel or half an orange slice.

name: Dry Martini
ingredients: 60ml Gin, 10ml Dry Vermouth
desc: The quintessential sophisticated cocktail, highlighting the botanical profile of dry gin.
recipe: Pour 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth into a mixing glass filled with ice cubes.
Stir well for about 30 seconds until the glass is very cold.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with a green olive or a twist of lemon peel.
Substitutions: Vermouth with dry white wine or sake

name: Manhattan
ingredients: 50ml Rye Whiskey, 20ml Sweet Red Vermouth, 1 dash Angostura Bitters
desc: A smooth, spirit-forward classic that showcases the spice of rye whiskey tempered by herbal vermouth.
recipe: Combine 50ml rye whiskey, 20ml sweet vermouth, and 1 dash of bitters in a mixing glass with ice.
Stir until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe or cocktail glass.
Garnish with a single maraschino cherry.

name: New York Sour
ingredients: 60ml Whiskey, 30ml Fresh Lemon Juice, 22.5ml Simple Syrup, 15ml Fruity Red Wine, 1 Egg White (optional)
desc: A sophisticated variation of the Whiskey Sour featuring a striking red wine float that adds a fruity aromatic layer.
recipe: Add whiskey, lemon juice, simple syrup, and egg white to a shaker.
Dry shake without ice to emulsify the egg white.
Add ice and shake again until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice.
Slowly pour the red wine over the back of a bar spoon so it floats on the surface.

name: Daiquiri
ingredients: 60ml White Rum, 20ml Fresh Lime Juice, 2 bar spoons Superfine Sugar
desc: A crisp, refreshing Cuban classic that relies on the perfect ratio of rum to citrus.
recipe: Add 2 bar spoons of sugar and 20ml fresh lime juice to a cocktail shaker; stir to dissolve.
Add 60ml white rum and fill the shaker with ice.
Shake vigorously for 15 seconds.
Double strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

name: Margarita
ingredients: 50ml Tequila (100% Agave), 20ml Triple Sec, 15ml Fresh Lime Juice
desc: The most popular tequila cocktail in the world, balancing sour, sweet, and salty notes.
recipe: Rim a chilled glass with salt using a lime wedge.
Add 50ml tequila, 20ml triple sec, and 15ml lime juice to a shaker with ice.
Shake well until the shaker is frosted.
Strain into the prepared glass over fresh ice or served neat.
Substitution: Triple Sec with Orange Juice

name: Espresso Martini
ingredients: 50ml Vodka, 30ml Coffee Liqueur, 10ml Sugar Syrup, 1 shot Fresh Espresso
desc: A modern classic providing a cold, caffeinated kick with a signature frothy head.
recipe: Add 50ml vodka, 30ml coffee liqueur, 10ml sugar syrup, and a fresh shot of espresso to a shaker.
Fill with ice and shake hard to create a thick foam.
Strain immediately into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish with three coffee beans in a petal formation.

name: Mojito
ingredients: 45ml White Rum, 20ml Fresh Lime Juice, 6 Mint Sprigs, 2 tsp White Sugar, Soda Water
desc: A vibrant, minty highball that is a staple of Cuban cocktail culture.
recipe: Muddle 6 mint sprigs with 2 tsp sugar and 20ml lime juice in a highball glass.
Add a splash of soda water and fill the glass with cracked ice.
Pour in 45ml rum and stir well.
Top with more soda water and garnish with a mint sprig.

name: Gimlet
ingredients: 60ml Gin, 22.5ml Fresh Lime Juice, 22.5ml Simple Syrup
desc: A sharp, botanical classic known for its crisp balance of gin and citrus.
recipe: Add gin, lime juice, and simple syrup into a shaker with ice.
Shake well until chilled.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass or coupe.
Garnish with a lime wheel.

name: Moscow Mule
ingredients: 45ml Vodka, 15ml Fresh Lime Juice, 120ml Ginger Beer
desc: A refreshing, spicy highball traditionally served in a copper mug.
recipe: Squeeze lime juice into a copper mug or highball glass.
Add ice cubes and pour in the vodka.
Fill with cold ginger beer.
Stir gently and garnish with a lime slice.

name: Whiskey Sour
ingredients: 45ml Bourbon Whiskey, 30ml Fresh Lemon Juice, 15ml Simple Syrup, 1 bar spoon Egg White
desc: A rich, silky cocktail that balances the bite of bourbon with tart citrus.
recipe: Combine 45ml bourbon, 30ml lemon juice, 15ml syrup, and egg white in a shaker.
Shake without ice first (dry shake) to create foam.
Add ice and shake again (wet shake) until cold.
Strain into a chilled glass and garnish with a cherry.

name: Cosmopolitan
ingredients: 40ml Vodka Citron, 15ml Cointreau, 15ml Fresh Lime Juice, 30ml Cranberry Juice
desc: A stylish, tart-sweet cocktail made famous by modern pop culture.
recipe: Add 40ml vodka, 15ml Cointreau, 15ml lime juice, and 30ml cranberry juice to a shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously.
Double strain into a large chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with a lime wheel or flamed orange zest.

name: Dark ‘n Stormy
ingredients: 60ml Goslings Black Seal Rum, 100ml Ginger Beer, 15ml Fresh Lime Juice (optional)
desc: A rich, spicy highball with a dramatic layered appearance.
recipe: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add ginger beer and lime juice.
Float the dark rum on top by pouring it slowly over the back of a spoon.
Garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Paloma
ingredients: 50ml Tequila Blanco, 10ml Fresh Lime Juice, Grapefruit Soda
desc: Mexico's most popular cocktail, offering a tart and effervescent grapefruit profile.
recipe: Rim a highball glass with salt (optional).
Add tequila and lime juice to the glass.
Fill with ice and top with grapefruit soda.
Stir gently and garnish with a grapefruit wedge.

name: Bee’s Knees
ingredients: 60ml Gin, 22.5ml Fresh Lemon Juice, 22.5ml Honey Syrup
desc: A Prohibition-era classic that is bright, citrusy, and floral.
recipe: Combine gin, lemon juice, and honey syrup in a shaker with ice.
Shake vigorously until well-chilled.
Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
Garnish with a lemon twist.

name: Gold Rush
ingredients: 60ml Bourbon, 22.5ml Fresh Lemon Juice, 22.5ml Honey Syrup
desc: A modern classic that adds a rich honey sweetness to the traditional whiskey sour template.
recipe: Add bourbon, lemon juice, and honey syrup to a shaker with ice.
Shake until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass over a large ice cube.
Garnish with a lemon peel or ginger slice.

name: French 75
ingredients: 30ml Gin, 15ml Lemon Juice, 15ml Simple Syrup, 60ml Champagne
desc: An elegant, effervescent cocktail with a powerful kick.
recipe: Shake gin, lemon juice, and simple syrup with ice.
Strain into a champagne flute.
Top with champagne.
Garnish with a lemon spiral.

name: Bay Breeze
ingredients: 60ml Vodka, 90ml Cranberry Juice, 30ml Pineapple Juice
desc: A tropical, fruity highball that is easy to drink and vibrant in color.
recipe: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add vodka, cranberry juice, and pineapple juice.
Stir well to combine.
Garnish with a lime slice.

name: Black Russian
ingredients: 50ml Vodka, 25ml Coffee Liqueur
desc: A simple, robust duo that highlights the deep flavor of coffee.
recipe: Pour vodka and coffee liqueur into an old fashioned glass filled with ice.
Stir gently.
Serve without garnish (optional maraschino cherry).

name: Cuba Libre
ingredients: 50ml White Rum, 120ml Cola, 10ml Fresh Lime Juice
desc: A classic highball that improves upon the simple Rum and Coke with the essential addition of fresh lime.
recipe: Squeeze lime juice into a highball glass.
Fill the glass with ice cubes.
Add the rum and top with chilled cola.
Stir gently to combine.
Garnish with a lime wedge.

name: Piña Colada
ingredients: 60ml White Rum, 90ml Fresh Pineapple Juice, 30ml Coconut Cream, 15ml Fresh Lime Juice (optional)
desc: A tropical, creamy classic from Puerto Rico that balances sweet coconut and tart pineapple.
recipe: Add rum, pineapple juice, coconut cream, and lime juice into a blender.
Add 1 cup of crushed ice and blend until smooth.
Pour into a chilled Hurricane glass.
Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a maraschino cherry.

name: Mint Julep
ingredients: 60ml Bourbon, 4-5 Fresh Mint Sprigs, 7.5ml Simple Syrup, Crushed Ice
desc: A cornerstone of Southern hospitality, this refreshing bourbon drink is defined by its aromatic mint and frosty presentation.
recipe: Place mint leaves and simple syrup in a Julep cup or rocks glass.
Muddle gently to release the mint oils without shredding the leaves.
Add the bourbon and fill the cup halfway with crushed ice.
Stir well until the glass begins to frost.
Mound more crushed ice on top and garnish with a large, slapped mint sprig.

name: Long Island Iced Tea
ingredients: 15ml Vodka, 15ml Tequila, 15ml White Rum, 15ml Gin, 15ml Triple Sec, 25ml Fresh Lemon Juice, 30ml Simple Syrup, Splash of Cola
desc: A potent, high-volume cocktail that mimics the color and flavor of iced tea despite containing no tea.
recipe: Add all ingredients except the cola into a highball glass filled with ice.
Stir gently to combine.
Top with a splash of cola for color.
Garnish with a lemon slice and serve with a straw.
